scientific_target: Test the exact iterated BA22 first-true/restriction compilation route on the pair-block killer family and determine the number of reachable pairwise semantically distinct exact residual DBO states after t foreign clauses.

scope.foreign_CNF: Gamma_m = AND_i C_i with C_i=(a_i OR b_i)
scope.input_structural_scale: Theta(m): 2m DBO variable references + m binary clauses + 2m foreign literal occurrences

frozen_route.KEEP_i: a_i=TRUE, b_i unassigned; block {a_i,b_i} restricts to singleton {b_i}

candidate_theorems.state_invariant: R_{t,S}=DBO({b_i} for i in S, {a_i,b_i} for i=t+1..m), with S subseteq [t]
candidate_theorems.strategy_barrier: Repeated exact BA22 residual-state compilation is not a general polynomial-state route for this frozen family if all distinct residual states are materialized/memoized explicitly.

reachability_certificate: For each S subseteq [t], accumulated guard sets a_i=TRUE for i in S and a_i=FALSE,b_i=TRUE for i in [t]\S; this satisfies all processed clauses and leaves exactly R_{t,S}.
semantic_distinctness_certificate: For S!=T choose j in symmetric difference. Assign the singleton b_j TRUE on the side where j survives, all other processed singleton variables FALSE, and every untouched block false (e.g. a_i=FALSE,b_i=FALSE). Exactly one residual evaluates TRUE.

order_robustness_candidate.statement: For any permutation of pair clauses, and either literal order inside each C_i, every processed independent pair contributes one binary residual-state coordinate (singleton of the untested mate versus killed block), hence 2^t states after any t processed clauses.

no_materialization_theorem_proof.finite_diagnostics: m=1..12 allowed; m=64 symbolic expected-count diagnostic only
no_materialization_theorem_proof.generic_authority: induction + explicit guard construction + semantic separator witness

witness_and_reconstruction.selected_reachable_states: construct projected assignments satisfying processed C_i and residual DBO
witness_and_reconstruction.optional_sealed_source_embedding: selected controls may be embedded into sealed BA21/BA20 source reconstruction; exponential-state theorem itself has no BA4 brute-force dependency

falsifiers.F1: Some subset state S is unreachable.
falsifiers.F2: Two different subsets yield semantically identical residuals.
falsifiers.F3: State count after t is not 2^t.
falsifiers.F4: Final exact state count is not 2^m.
falsifiers.F5: More than one final state is FALSE.
falsifiers.F9: Canonical exact residual memoization merges distinct subset states.
falsifiers.F10: Generic theorem relies on enumerating all 2^m states.
falsifiers.F11: Order robustness is promoted without proof.
falsifiers.F12: State explosion is misreported as a lower bound for every knowledge-compilation language.
falsifiers.F13: State explosion is misreported as SAT decision hardness.

nonclaims: Boolean function lacks another compact representation
arbitrary CNF requires exponential decision time

after_gate.future_frontier_only: hybrid compact semantic factor + uncompiled foreign CNF, parameterized by interaction structure
